product.name: Pinzon Polished Nickel Orb Table Lamp with Black Shade
product.description: Bright silver table lamp with classic black drum shade beautifully enhances urban and modern decors Chrome-plated metal base; cotton shade; silver cord; matching finial Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 3-way switch for adjustable lighting Arrives assembled for immediate enjoyment; matching floor lamp available separately Measures 36 inches high by 14 inches wide; weighs approximately 10 pounds
